    depth = [0]*(n+1)
    size = [0]*(n+1)
    heavy = [-1]*(n+1)

    def dfs(u):

        max_size = 0
        for v in adj[u]:

                parent[v] = u
                depth[v] = depth[u] + 1
                dfs(v)
                size[u] += size[v]
                if size[v] > max_size:
                    max_size = size[v]
                    heavy[u] = v
    dfs(1)

    pos = [0]*(n+1)
    current_pos = 1

        head[u] = h
        pos[u] = current_pos
        current_pos += 1

            decompose(heavy[u], h)
        for v in adj[u]:
            if v != parent[u] and v != heavy[u]:
                decompose(v, v)
    decompose(1, 1)

            self.size = 1
            while self.size < self.n:

            r += self.size
            while l <= r:
                if l % 2 == 1:
                    self.tree[l].add(val)
                    l += 1
                if r % 2 == 0:
                    self.tree[r].add(val)
                    r -= 1
                l //= 2
                r //= 2

        def query_point(self, pos):
            res = set()
            pos += self.size
            while pos >= 1:
                res.update(self.tree[pos])
                pos //= 2
            return res

    st = SegmentTree(n+2)

            u = parent[head[u]]
        # Process subtree of b
        u = b
        while u != 0:
            l = pos[u]
            r = pos[u] + size[u] - 1
            st.update_range(l, r, op)
            u = parent[head[u]]

    # Collect all node lists
